title: Houston finds crystal dice hidden for a son-in-law

tellings.quote: like came home from school and found those cuz he could like hear them or feel them energy

plain: Houston Asher is a young man in Atlanta who does not speak. His mother, Katie Asher, says he once came home from school and found some crystal dice she had hidden for her son-in-law, because, she says, he could hear or feel their energy. The documentary maker Ky Dickens, whose series The Telepathy Tapes follows nonspeaking people like Houston, tells Michels the story as the mother told it, as evidence that such people sense things others cannot.
